label: D2 after choosing a2, previous trial common & unrewarded, in the last ~5 trials of the episode
explanation: Sparse feature that fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0 at D1; 100% of mass), almost only after the agent chose a2 (97% of mass), and only in the final 10 trials of the 100-trial episode (all activations at ep_trial 90-99, concentrated at 95+); it coincides with the lowest value-head bin. The previous trial being a common transition adds precision (92% of mass). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a rewarded trial, or before ep_trial 90. All variables are observable at D2 (the choice and reached state are already shown), so no future variable is used. Precision is limited (~0.4 on dev): many late-episode a2 D2 steps after a common-unrewarded trial stay silent, so a further unidentified factor (likely a continuous end-of-episode / low-value signal) gates it. Activations in the upper quartiles are better covered by the late-episode condition than those in the lower quartiles (coverage 0.79/0.81/0.96/0.97 for ep_trial>=95).
